[u]About this mod[/u][/size]
[b]
Fast fish ponds. [/b]
[list]
[*][size=2]Fish always take 1 day to replicate. [/size]
[*][size=2]Optional rebalancing to increase chance and quantity of non-roe items. [/size]
[/list][size=2]
[u]Features[/u]

[list]
[*]Configurable replication time.
[*]Turn rebalancing on/off. 
[*]Choose multiplicative bonus (default 1.5x). 
[*]Compatible with GMCM on title screen.  
[/list][/size]
[b][u][size=2]Instructions[/size]
[/u][/b]
1. Download [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
2. Unzip the file into your Mods folder
3. Spend a full in-game day (i.e. go to sleep) for mod to go into effect  

[b][u]Configuration
[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b][i]spawnTime[/i][/b] (default 1): days it takes for fish to grow.
[*][b][i]vanilla[/i][/b] (default true): make false to add minor rebalancing of fish pond outputs.
[*][b][i]multiplier [/i][/b](default 1.5): ﻿multiplicative bonus added to the chance of non-roe items (config file only). 
[/list]
[b][u]Support
[/u][/b]
This mod is [url=https://github.com/zeldela/sdv-mods/tree/main/sdv-mods/]open-source[/url].

[i]Known issues: 
[/i]
[list]
[*]Most features require a game restart when changed.
[*]Mod requires going to sleep in save file before taking effect. 
[/list]
